notes.title: New Alpha Version of Any World Now Available!
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear friends![/h2]

We are excited to announce that after a two-year break, we have finally released a new alpha version of Any World! The last update was in 2023, and since then the game has undergone tremendous changes.

[previewyoutube=YNrpsKYkxgs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new:[/h2]

🏙 EmriTown — a full-fledged location with a unique visual style and plenty of secrets

👥 New characters — meet the charismatic residents of EmriTown, each with their own story

💰 Collectibles — explore every corner of the city in search of chests and coins

🎮 All of Ottis's core abilities — try out the main character's full arsenal of capabilities, including glove modules and special movements

🌟 Additional level — complete a special level that will test your platforming skills and gadget handling

This alpha version reflects our vision for the final product and demonstrates the key mechanics that will form the foundation of the full game. We look forward to your feedback, which will help us make Any World even better!

Thank you for your patience and support!

The IdeaGame Team

notes.title: DEMO VERSION! The Rebirth of Any World!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone I am glad to share with you the news that very soon we will release a big update of the demo version of Any World, or rather a practical completely redesigned game.

What will be in the new demo version:

[list]
[*]Bug fix
[*]New graphics
[*]New models
[*]A completely new plot
[*]Test map, part of the world
[*]30 minutes of gameplay
[*]Secrets
[/list]

This is just a part of the demo version that we can reveal now, the rest you will see for yourself.

For a whole year we completely changed everything in Any World and tried to come to a conditional ideal of the game, there were a lot of different ideas, concepts that we eventually used, then changing them very much, but as a result, it is now clear for sure that the game has become and will be even better than in 2022!

Expect new news soon.

Our team, IdeaGame.
